thread:
devon: Hey all — first week here, quick access help pls. I need GCP quota bump for asia-southeast1 (project: redwood-devon), link to the RWD-Dev billing account, and KMS key access so our service account can decrypt model artifacts in APAC. Also need an AWS cross-account role to pull S3 logs (arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RWD-Logs-Reader). Who should I ping for billing link + KMS IAM + quota? Thanks! :wave:

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-2345 for cloud access requests. Please include project id, billing account id, and the KMS key resource name. ETA: cloud-ops will triage during business hours.

sarah: @devon welcome! I can take the KMS + quota bits. Quick questions: what's the exact project id (not display name), and do you need compute quota (CPUs) or regional network/IO quotas? For KMS, paste the full key resource name like projects/PROJECT/locations/asia-southeast1/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/key.

devon: Project id is redwood-devon-42. Quota: primarily CPUs (n1-standard) + persistent disk IOPS for model eval jobs. KMS key path is projects/redwood-devon-42/locations/asia-southeast1/keyRings/models/cryptoKeys/decrypt-key.

sarah: OK got it. Steps I'll do: 1) request CPU quota increase (will open GCP console quota request), 2) add IAM binding for service account redwood-runner@redwood-devon-42.iam.gserviceaccount.com with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on that key, 3) confirm billing link. Example commands I might run (for reference):

```
# link billing
gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-devon-42 --billing-account=0000AA-0000BB-0000CC
# add KMS IAM
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding decrypt-key \
  --location=asia-southeast1 --keyring=models \
  --member="serviceAccount:redwood-runner@redwood-devon-42.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```
I can't run the billing link until billing team confirms the billing-account id.

alex: Hi @devon — billing here. Which billing account name are you expecting? We have RWD-Dev-Billing (ID: 01A2B3-XXXXXX). If you want me to attach redwood-devon-42, confirm and I will do the link. Also: do you need billing export enabled?

kyle: re: quota — if this is urgent you can use a quick fallback to us-central1 for short runs while asia quota is provisioned. CPU quota request to GCP usually takes 1-3 business days; PD IOPS sometimes longer. Please file the GCP quota request form (https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas) and CC me so I can escalate. Also be aware of org-policy that prevents public external IPs in APAC; if your workloads need external egress we can add a NAT or use private egress.

mel: Hi devon! I'm onboarding lead — welcome :tada:. Please fill the cloud access checklist here: https://redwood-internal.tools/onboarding/cloud-access (step 2 has project + billing fields). If you want, I can prefill some fields and assign to cloud-ops. Also we'll provision a short-lived dev role so you can iterate while infra finishes permanent bindings.

devon: Thanks everyone — I'll fill the checklist now and paste the billing account ID once alex confirms. Two quick follow-ups: (1) For the AWS cross-account role, do I need to open a separate ticket or can we add it to the same INC-2345? (2) For KMS, will the service account need key ring admin or just encrypter/decrypter?

sarah: (1) Add AWS details to INC-2345, that keeps everything in one place. (2) You only need encrypter/decrypter for runtime; keyRotation or admin roles are separate and we won't grant them by default. If ops needs rotation rights we can set up a separate service account.

alex: Confirmed billing account ID is 01A2B3-XXXXXX. I'll link it to redwood-devon-42 once you add it to the checklist or reply here "link please". I can also enable billing export to BigQuery if you want cost visibility.

devon: link please — and yes enable export to a dev dataset. Also added AWS role ARN and S3 bucket name to INC-2345. Appreciate the quick help :pray:.

ops-bot: INC-2345 updated: billing link requested (pending approval), KMS IAM binding queued, GCP quota request submitted. Cloud-ops assignee: sarah. Billing assignee: alex. Expected next update in ~8 hours.
